in_sanskrit.name: भविता
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: She who is the embodiment of existence

in_marathi.name: Bhavita
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Desiring, longing for
in_marathi.long_meaning: Bhavita हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। A name derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Bhav’ which means to be or to exist and the suffix ‘ita’ meaning the one who desires or longs for. In Hindu mythology, Bhavita is the name of a goddess who embodies the desire or longing for spiritual growth and enlightenment.
